summary: Improve agile planning, code review and software testing routines. Explore this five-day foundation course and strengthen your engineering workflow.
lede: Agile software engineering practices help delivery teams turn feature requests into traceable, reviewable increments. For junior developers, QA analysts, product owners and engineering leads, the course develops skills in slicing testable stories, setting workflow policies, reviewing code changes and selecting tests. Learners also interpret delivery metrics and prepare improvement briefs, with test-driven development and pipeline design covered at foundation level.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for people who contribute to software delivery or quality and need a practical foundation in agile engineering routines.
prerequisites: Basic familiarity with how software features are requested, developed or supported is useful. No programming or coding is required; exercises focus on analysing scenarios and producing engineering workflow artefacts.
